brief.headline: Push for a 10–15% price cut: they keep 8.5% profit vs 4.8% peer average — real room to move

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a 10–15% price reduction on rigid plastic packaging
priceAsk.target: Target range ₹0.65–0.80/pc for caps (market typical is ₹0.85–0.95/pc)
priceAsk.basis: They keep 8.5% of every sale as profit while similar firms keep only 4.8% — that 3.7 point gap is room for a better price. The open market shows caps asking ₹0.55–1.20/pc with headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move payment terms from 45 days to 30 days

brief.financialLeverage: Triveni is financially strong — no debt (0.00x), keeps a comfortable 8.5% profit, and sits in the safe zone (6.18 Altman score). Their cash is stuck for 124 days, longer than peers at 114 days, so they'd value faster payment. But we're tiny to them — just 0.15% of their ₹179.69 Cr revenue — so we need to lean on the market alternatives and bundle volume or lock in a longer commitment to get real movement on price and terms.

evidence.point: They keep much more profit than peers
We are a very small customer to them
Their cash is tied up longer than similar firms
They have no debt and high interest cover
Market reference for PP caps shows room at volume
Moving payment to 30 days frees cash for us

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue — does pharma bottles, caps, preforms and is the top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed, strong (B 73/100 health), ₹1010.97 Cr revenue — makes pails, containers, pharma packaging; robust alternate for bottles and closures

risks: We're only 0.15% of their business (₹26.17 L of ₹179.69 Cr) — on our own we have little pull; bundle more volume or play them against Manjushree to get real traction
They have EPF payment delays flagged — watch for any delivery or quality hiccups that signal cash or operation stress

Market backups like Reliance, IVL Dhunseri and Ganesha Ecosphere are leads to qualify (verify before RFQ) — not yet priced or audited, so line up Manjushree or Mold-Tek as your immediate second source
Their cash cycle is longer than peers (124d vs 114d) so faster payment is genuinely valuable to them — but don't give it away free; tie it to a meaningful price cut
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to lock in a longer commitment with you, but we need a 10–15% price improvement and 30-day terms to make the business case work — your profit margin gives us confidence there's room.
